mutants.why: appActionServiceTracksSessionArtifactRootWithoutFallback requires no-session output to stay empty instead of escaping to an AppData fallback, and requires active-session output to use private staging rather than the managed artifact tree.
appActionServiceTracksSessionArtifactRootWithoutFallback requires a new session and a renamed session to retarget the existing service to a fresh private staging directory.
appActionArtifactImportRejectsStagedJunction plants a junction in private app-action staging and requires publication to fail before any redirected tree is copied into managed artifacts.
appActionArtifactImportRejectsStagedJunction also requires cleanup to remove the junction itself without descending into and deleting the outside target.
